decision.observation: 7 mph, gear 1, timer 49:31.054, red X lit. The car sits on grass between the white rail fence and a big dark pine trunk on its LEFT; the gravel road body is about two car widths to the right, curving up-frame. Oil banners line the fence.
decision.hypothesis: Turning right moves away from both the trunk and the fence, so a W+D beat should carry the car back onto the gravel without the stall that plain W into the verge produces.
decision.memory: The plain-W build at only 7-8 mph still let the car drift left off the gravel onto this fence-side grass - road camber pulls left here. Correct early with a right beat rather than waiting for the pin.
